title: From Neurons to Networks
description: Trace the complete history of neural networks - from McCulloch-Pitts' logical neurons through the perceptron controversy, the backpropagation revival, and the deep learning revolution that gave us modern AI.
targetAudience: Those wanting to understand neural network architecture evolution
keyTakeaways: The Perceptrons book nearly killed neural networks for a decade
Backpropagation enabled training of multi-layer networks
AlexNet proved deep learning's superiority in 2012
Skip connections in ResNet enabled training networks 1000+ layers deep
